description: This file defines an interface IController for the WPEFramework plugin host, including several virtual methods related to device or system control such as Persist, Delete, Reboot, Environment, Configuration, and Clone.

classes.name: IController
classes.description: An interface for controlling or managing system or device states, marked as deprecated and external, with methods for persistence, deletion, reboot, environment retrieval, configuration, and cloning.

methods.name: Persist
methods.description: Persists the current state or configuration.

methods.name: Delete
methods.description: Deletes a resource specified by the path.

methods.name: Environment
methods.description: Retrieves environment information based on an index.

methods.name: Configuration (getter)
methods.description: Retrieves configuration data for a given callsign.

methods.name: Configuration (setter)
methods.description: Sets configuration data for a given callsign.

methods.name: Clone
methods.description: Clones a resource from a base callsign to a new callsign.
